description.ja: DeepSeek AIの数学特化LLM。2024年2月5日公開。DeepSeek-Coder-v1.5 7Bから初期化し、追加5000億トークンで学習。Group Relative Policy Optimization（GRPO）という新しい強化学習手法を導入。ツール使用時にMATH 58.8%達成、競技数学でGemini-Ultra/GPT-4に迫る性能。
description.en: DeepSeek AI's math-specialized LLM. Released February 5, 2024. Initialized from DeepSeek-Coder-v1.5 7B with 500B additional tokens. Introduces Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), a novel RL method. Achieves 58.8% on MATH with tool use, approaching Gemini-Ultra/GPT-4 on competition math.

specs.architecture: Based on DeepSeek-Coder-v1.5 7B, GRPO (Group Relative Policy Optimization), Process Reward Model (PRM), Tool-integrated math solving

description.ja: 7Bベースモデル。事前学習版。MATH 36.2%達成。
description.en: 7B base model. Pre-trained version. Achieves 36.2% on MATH.

description.ja: 7B SFTチューニング版。指示追従に最適化。
description.en: 7B SFT-tuned variant. Optimized for instruction following.

description.ja: 7B GRPO強化学習版。ツール使用時MATH 58.8%達成。
description.en: 7B GRPO reinforcement learning variant. Achieves 58.8% on MATH with tool use.
